description: Use when an order has missed its expected delivery time and the customer wants help with the delay.
text: The driver hasn’t shown up and the delivery time came and went. Please look into it.

description: Applies when someone wants to book timed-entry admission for a museum visit.
text: Would you be able to book a spot for my family of five on Friday afternoon?

description: The customer needs landline equipment or service options suited to an accessibility requirement.
text: The normal ringtone doesn’t wake my partner, who has significant hearing loss. Do you have a vibrating or extra-loud alert device?

description: Use when someone wants confirmation or an update about an existing reservation.
text: I got a notification about my booking, but I’m not sure what it means. Is my stay confirmed?

description: Applies when someone asks whether the service or a feature works on a particular device or platform.
text: Will live games work in Chrome on a Chromebook?

domain: Corporate catering and lunch delivery service
description: The customer requests changes to ingredients, sides, portion sizes, or meal preparation.
text: Could you make the portions a little smaller for the afternoon meeting?

description: Use when someone asks about services, collections, or activities specifically for children or teens.
text: My daughter is starting kindergarten. Do you run any programs to help kids get ready to read?

description: Use when someone wants to cancel an existing reservation in full.
text: We need to give up our campsite reservation for August 2–5. Can you cancel it?

description: Applies when the customer asks which days or times regular waste or recycling is collected at their address.
text: When are residents on Elm Terrace meant to put their bins out?

description: Use when the user reports inappropriate content or behavior in a learner community.
text: A discussion has turned into personal insults and name-calling. Could a moderator step in?

description: Use when someone asks about accessibility features or needs help finding a rental suited to accessibility requirements.
text: I’m looking for a rental with visual alert devices for a guest who is hard of hearing.

description: Applies when someone asks whether pest-control service is available at a particular location.
text: Do you come out to Maplewood?

description: Applies when someone asks about eye exams, eyewear, or optical department services.
text: Do I need to be a member to get new glasses from the optical department?

description: Use when the user cannot finish or receive completion credit for a specific lesson.
text: I’m stuck on the last screen of Lesson 6. There’s no way to finish it.

description: Use when the customer asks about available service features, plan differences, or which option suits their needs.
text: What’s the difference between your basic mailbox plan and the one with package handling?

description: Use when someone needs help writing, finding, or responding to a review about a stay.
text: I’d like to see the comments people have posted about my property before I book again.

description: Applies when someone wants to reserve an overnight boarding stay for their pet.
text: We’ll be visiting family for the holiday, so please set up a five-night stay for our cat, beginning the evening of the 23rd.

description: Use when a buyer received a different title, author, edition, or format than the one ordered.
text: I ordered *The Hobbit*, but the parcel contains *The Silmarillion*.

description: Use when someone needs to request, send, or understand an official or unofficial academic transcript.
text: Do I need to request a separate record for each campus I attended?

description: The person seeks general guidance about symptoms, injury management, or whether physiotherapy may help, without asking to book a specific appointment.
text: How long should I take it easy after a mild hamstring strain before trying to run again?

description: The customer needs to locate, reset, or understand the SIP username, password, or server settings for a device.
text: The phone setup page asks for an authentication name—is that the same as my login?

description: Applies when someone asks about tire availability, installation, appointments, or tire center services.
text: Can I book an appointment to have my tires rotated this Friday?

description: Applies when someone asks how to sign a student up for bus service, confirm eligibility, or check enrollment status.
text: I filled out the online form, but there’s no confirmation email. Could you verify that Noah is registered?

description: Use when the player needs help connecting or disconnecting a publisher account and a console-platform account.
text: My console says this profile is already connected somewhere else. How can I pair the right accounts?

domain: Hostel guest support and room bookings
description: Use when someone wants to change dates, guest count, room type, or other details of an existing reservation.
text: I made a reservation for the wrong weekend. Please shift it from 5–7 May to 12–14 May.

description: Use when the customer needs help choosing a route, transfer, or journey between metro stops.
text: I’m at Oak Street and need to reach the airport. Where should I change lines?

description: Use when a learner needs help contacting an instructor, mentor, or teaching assistant.
text: Quick question: are instructor office hours still on Wednesdays, and how do I join?

description: Use when someone asks for a general update on an order that has been placed.
text: Could you check whether my package is on its way? The confirmation number is 48271.

description: Applies when someone asks what to do before the cleaner arrives, such as moving furniture or clearing the area.
text: Do you move larger furniture, or should I arrange for someone to help me?

description: Applies when someone asks whether a room is available for specific dates or guest numbers.
text: Do you have a room for two adults on October 12–14?

description: Use when someone shares general feedback or dissatisfaction that does not fit a more specific service issue.
text: I appreciate having free internet around town. It makes waiting for the bus a little easier.

description: Applies when an item appears lost or has no useful tracking updates, without being marked as delivered.
text: A package I sent to my sister seems to have disappeared between sorting centres. There are no recent records.

description: Applies when someone asks about pharmacy hours, location, pickup procedures, or whether another person can collect medication.
text: Which entrance should I use to get to the pharmacy inside the hospital?

domain: Payroll and workforce scheduling software provider
description: Use when someone asks about the status or progress of a payroll run.
text: The team is asking about payday. Is this cycle still processing or has it gone through?

description: Use when someone opens the assigned compartment but finds no parcel inside.
text: The door opened, but there’s no package inside.

description: Use when someone asks whether an item contains or may come into contact with an allergen.
text: Can someone with a wheat allergy safely order the lettuce-wrapped burger?

description: Use when someone asks how to join the health plan, confirms enrollment, or reports a problem enrolling.
text: Does my new coverage with your plan start automatically, or do I need to do something first?

description: Use when controls are unresponsive, settings cannot be changed, or an error code is displayed.
text: None of the buttons on the fridge panel respond when I press them.

description: Use when someone asks how weather may affect the event or what to bring for forecast conditions.
text: Should I wear wellies this weekend, or are the grounds usually okay after rain?

description: Use when the player needs help downloading, installing, updating, or removing a game.
text: The installer stops at 70 percent every time. Any ideas?

description: Applies when the customer asks whether a device supports the operator’s network, SIM, or available network features.
text: Does the Galaxy A14 support Wi-Fi calling on your network?

description: Applies when tracking shows an unexpected disruption, such as a hold or route issue, and the customer wants to know what it means.
text: My parcel shows a route disruption notice. Can you explain what’s going on?

description: Use when someone reports that a parcel or its contents were damaged on arrival.
text: My delivery arrived with a big tear down the side. Some of the contents are scratched too.

description: The customer asks for the store’s address, directions, or nearby landmarks.
text: Can you give me the address? My map is showing two places with a similar name.

description: Applies when a customer asks to revise an existing estimate because the move details or requested services have changed.
text: The quote was for a two-bedroom apartment, but we’re moving into a three-bedroom house now. Can you update the numbers?

description: Applies when someone asks about booking, changing, or canceling an individual guest room in connection with an event.
text: I’m attending the sales conference—can I book one room for myself for October 17?

description: The customer needs help viewing or correcting the caller information shown for incoming calls.
text: Is there a setting that makes the number of whoever’s calling show on my handset?

description: Use when someone needs help completing, correcting, or understanding a passport application form.
text: The online form won’t accept my name with a hyphen. How am I supposed to enter it?

description: Applies when someone wants a parcel sent to a different delivery location, such as a pickup point.
text: Please redirect this shipment to the locker at Riverside Station.

description: Applies when someone moving to a new area asks for brokerage help planning a property search or move.
text: We’re leaving Chicago for Charleston and have no idea where to begin looking. Could an agent help us map out the search and timing?

description: Use when someone asks whether a vehicle was towed, where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.
text: Where do I go to pick up a vehicle that was removed from downtown?

description: Use when someone needs help updating their username, bio, profile details, or public-facing settings.
text: My profile still shows my old location. Where do I edit that?

description: Use when someone shares general feedback, praise, or a non-urgent suggestion about district services.
text: The new signs at the high school make it much easier to find the right entrance. Thanks!

description: Use when someone wants to cancel an existing appointment without arranging a replacement time.
text: Could you take me off the schedule for Thursday? I’m not looking to rebook at this time.

description: The customer requests an onsite visit to assess waste types, quantities, or handling needs.
text: Would one of your technicians be able to come out, review our waste area, and recommend a collection plan?

domain: Theater box office and performance support
description: Use when someone asks whether late arrivals can enter and how seating is handled after a performance begins.
text: My bus might run late. Will ushers let us enter once the play is underway?

description: Use when someone requests an interpreter or help accessing housing services in another language.
text: I speak Somali and would like someone to interpret when I talk with my housing worker.

description: Use when someone asks about the progress, timing, or outcome of an existing maintenance request.
text: Just checking whether there’s been any progress on the dripping bathroom tap I submitted last week.

description: Applies when someone asks about the meaning or implications of a dermatology diagnosis they have received.
text: The doctor mentioned alopecia areata at my visit. What causes that condition?

description: Applies when someone asks what luggage they can bring or where to store it during a journey.
text: Where should I put my bags once I board?

description: Use when a customer asks whether a product or configuration is currently in stock.
text: Are the replacement tips for the Galaxy Buds Pro available at the moment?

description: Applies when recent DNS or nameserver changes are not yet visible or appear inconsistent across networks.
text: It’s been a few hours since I made the change and the old destination keeps appearing on my laptop.

description: Use when someone wants to ask a freelancer whether they can handle work that differs from the listed service.
text: Your listing is for a one-page site, but could you build a three-page version instead?

description: Applies when someone asks about renewing or extending an existing membership.
text: My card runs out soon. How do I keep it active?

description: Applies when a customer asks whether a product works with a particular pet, accessory, device, or setup.
text: Can I use this shampoo on a dog that’s also wearing a flea collar?

domain: Café chain offering mobile ordering and pickup
description: The customer cannot sign in to the mobile app or needs help recovering access.
text: New phone, and I can’t log in to my café account anymore. What should I do?

description: Use when a customer asks to cancel an existing order.
text: I placed an order for Friday, but my plans changed. Please cancel it.

description: Applies when a customer expresses dissatisfaction with a salon visit or service without specifically requesting a corrective appointment.
text: I asked for just a trim, but a lot more length came off than I wanted.

description: Applies when a customer needs help building, editing, or troubleshooting automated actions and rules in the CRM.
text: Our rule that sends a follow-up task after a form submission has stopped running. Can you help troubleshoot it?
